scientific_target: fresh independent validation of the post-Glanville two-layer EOG-WF predictor

response_semantics.positive_transition: county changes from not officially designated infested by year t to officially designated infested by year t+1
response_semantics.negative_transition: county remains without official infestation designation through t+1
response_semantics.boundary: recorded county infestation status, not latent biological absence or proof of a unique dispersal route
response_semantics.persistence: once a county is officially designated infested it remains in the current-source set for later transitions

source_process_boundary.later_sources: all counties officially designated infested by the current year
source_process_boundary.claim: conditional prediction of subsequent US county infestation designations from the observed invasion state
not_claimed: complete closure to every overseas reintroduction
source_process_boundary.long_distance_boundary: human-mediated long-distance spread is biologically plausible and must remain representable in at least one frozen rule world rather than being silently ruled out

response_independent_node_universe.definition: all 2020 Census county or county-equivalent nodes in the conterminous United States plus District of Columbia, excluding Alaska, Hawaii and Puerto Rico
response_independent_node_universe.reason: avoid the paper's 166-county convex-hull assessment region because that region was defined from counties known infested by 2021

frozen_response_source.allowed_pre_response_access: exact bytes may be transported for identity verification, but only the bounded first physical record may be parsed

published_pre_response_counts.source: Human-mediated dispersal drives the spread of the spotted lanternfly (published county counts)

prospective_evidence_rule.calibration_non_events: after response-free Census node count N is frozen, use lower=N-45
prospective_evidence_rule.heldout_non_events: after response-free Census node count N is frozen, use lower=N-130

gate0_pass_if: Census county bytes are reproducibly obtainable
conterminous county GEOIDs are unique and all have finite internal-point coordinates
response file git-blob identity matches the frozen commit
bounded header contains year, infested and fips
prospective aggregate estimability result is plausibly_eligible_pre_response
gate0_stop_if: response-independent county universe cannot be constructed
response header is incompatible with deterministic FIPS mapping
prospective event-count screen is uncertain or ineligible
any response row after the first physical record is parsed
after_gate0_if_pass: construct response-blind Haversine structural scale ladder from Census county internal points
require at least three distinct structural scales and the unchanged LCC90/isolation adequacy criteria
freeze Layer-A worlds including a long-distance-capable process world
freeze unchanged symmetric_world_support_summary_v1 and strong spread comparators
only then open county response once
no_rescue: Do not use the future-response-defined 166-county convex hull, do not alter the event split/minima after Gate 0, and do not open county response rows to design geometry or structural scales.
